statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain header 'Law Nos, 13 of 1975 62 of 1981 29 of 1984 10 of 1994'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into an 88-section tree in 7 parts with 8 definitions and no schedules. Other sources inspected: the Central Bank 1975 appendix (the Law as enacted, sections 1-86, no marginal notes) and a second LankaLaw HTML of the Law as enacted (86 sections, marginal notes, misfiled under amendments/html/), both used as verification sources; the section index (69 legacy entries); the commencement CSV; the two held scans, whose title pages were read. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 10 of 1994. Review performed: the opening words of all 88 sections searched in the print (83 found; the 5 misses are the two inserted sections, one 1984 rewording, section 29 and a punctuation case); every heading compared with the as-enacted HTML's marginal notes, with sections 29, 31A and 82 corrected and the HTML readings kept in heading_raw; the opening list of section 29 restored to the wording both as-enacted sources carry (recorded in text_correction); last provision of the six longest sections read against the print, four matching word for word and two (85, 31A) postdating it; validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and every remaining warning is documented in the trees. Not read word for word throughout. Amendment coverage: 3 instruments in the chain, all held as LankaLaw HTML and parsed, two also held as Government Printer scans without text layers; every marker in the consolidated text agrees with the amending Act's own section; all already incorporated, nothing applied. The 62 of 1981 and 10 of 1994 trees lack the bodies of the inserted sections 50A and 31A, which the pages carry and the consolidated tree holds. Structural weaknesses: the parser flattens substituted text in sections 7 (principal) and 2, 4, 6, 7 (10 of 1994); the consolidated page had swapped 'auditor' and 'secrecy' between the heading and text of section 29. Section count discrepancy: index 69 (legacy scrape of the appendix, not real section numbers) versus HTML 88 versus print 86 (as enacted, before 31A and 50A were inserted). Missing sources: a Government Printer text of the principal Law and of 10 of 1994; the Order appointing the date of operation. Unresolved questions: the appointed date of commencement (CSV and head date both give 15th May, 1975). Lawyer verification: unverified.
